children: Bank7 entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger to acquire Century Financial Services in a cash-and-stock transaction. Century shareholders will receive an aggregate $70 million in cash and 1,232,657 Bank7 shares, or $210.41 in cash and 3.7052 Bank7 shares per Century share, with cash paid for fractional shares. Following closing, Century Bank will merge into Bank7’s banking subsidiary. The deal is subject to Century shareholder approval, Federal Reserve and court approvals, and other customary conditions.
